mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.0% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, leading to reduced corporate revenue growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 105.0 indicates late-cycle manufacturing expansion, increasing overheating risks and triggering monetary tightening expectations that depress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting expectations of accelerated monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal labor market weakening, reducing consumer spending power and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer demand regime defined by RSAFS > 450,000 and HOUST > 1,200 increases inflation risks, triggering monetary policy tightening expectations that depress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 450000 and HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC for joint condition < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering immediate equity sell-offs due to reduced corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
